title: 第30章 脱离火窟
content_zh:
厉宏生突然在洞口叫道：“小兄弟，快攻温老太下盘。她这路刀法下三路不稳。”他在八卦刀上浸淫数十年，听着刀风的声音，便知她如何使刀。

    闵嘉庚正苦于一时不能取胜，听到厉宏生的叫声，心中大喜，弯腰弓身，伸拳往温老太腿上击去。温老太竟然不避，举刀往他背心直劈，她只求伤敌，已不顾自身。闵嘉庚扭腰侧身，让开了这刀，温老太第二刀连绵而上。她明听到厉宏生叫敌人攻击自己下盘，却偏不去守御。厉宏生大叫：“她在情急拼命，你夺不下她刀的。快想别法吧！”闵嘉庚心想：“这个我早知道，何必你来提醒？遇到这样个疯婆子，有什么法子？”

    狗洞外战斗激烈，闵嘉庚以一敌二，渐占上风，但要取胜，只怕还在百余回合之后。温老太瞧出情势不利，又听厉宏生不住叫嚷指点敌人，将破解八卦刀的诀窍一点点说了出来，恼怒异常，暗想：“你不给同门师哥报仇，已**不该，却反而相助敌人，当真是狼心狗肺的奸贼。”她却不想厉宏生身处绝境，若不反助闵嘉庚，性命已活不过一时三刻。她狂怒之下，心想：“这小杂种武艺高强，既逃了出来，只怕再难杀他。那么烧死了厅中这批奸人，也稍出我心中恶气。”大声呼喝佣工，急速多加柴炭焚烧。

    李云不住跺脚，埋怨闵嘉庚无用。厉宏明说：“王主任，快发暗器相助！”王万户手中早扣了十余枚暗器，但温老太等三人在狗洞旁恶斗，贴身而战，瞧不见准头而凭虚发射，怎保得定不会打中闵嘉庚？闵嘉庚心思机敏，早已想到这节，数次要引温老太到狗洞外。可温老太忌惮王万户暗器了得，始终不上这当。

    这时厅上焦臭渐浓，先是各人的头发胡子鬈曲烧焦，接着衣服边缘都卷了起来，各人呼吸也渐感艰难。陈梦梅抵受不住炙热，人已半晕。周银兵情急之下，伸头拼命向狗洞硬挤，但洞小头大，如何钻得出去？那狗洞四角均是极厚极重的花岗石，他双手扳住用力摇撼，动不了半分。

    厉宏明猛地想起：“闵嘉庚若有家伙，温老太岂是他敌手？我如何不早想到？”当即伸手去拾自己抛在地下的紫金刀。哪知这柄刀的刀头与地下铁板碰到，早已烤得炙热无比，他一抓之下，顿时疼得大叫一声。这时在铁厅上片刻也延挨不得，他忍着手上烫伤，撕下一块衣襟，裹住刀柄，左手将周银兵拉开，叫道：“闵嘉庚，家伙来啦！快接着。”手一挥，将钢刀从狗洞中抛了出去。闵嘉庚回身来接，温文新也听到了叫声，同时过来抢夺。只听两人同时惊呼一声，哐啷一响，两柄刀都跌在地下。

    原来闵嘉庚抢先抓到厉宏明的单刀，但刀柄奇热，一抓立即撒手。温文新跃到狗洞前，却被王万户一枝金钱镖打中手腕，手中钢刀也抛了下来。闵嘉庚一抓不中，温老太的紫金刀已袭到后心，他侧身闪过，抢到温文新身旁，猛地使一招“揿牛喝水”，举掌揿住他后颈，一运劲，温文新给他直按下去，面颊俯地，正好碰到厉宏明那柄烧得半红的单刀，嗤的一声，跟着低声惨呼，半边俊俏的脸庞上已烫出一条长长的焦痕。

    这声惨叫，厅上各人都是一喜，只道温文新已为闵嘉庚打伤。温老太复仇之心与母子之情在胸中略一交战，竟不顾儿子，举刀急往闵嘉庚肩头劈下。铛的一声，闵嘉庚却不闪避，翻腕横刀架开，原来他已趁隙将温文新的紫金刀抢在手中。

    厅上众人身处黑暗与奇热之中，但听双刀相交，叮叮当当乱响，知闵嘉庚已抢得武器，正在猛力急攻，各自多了一分指望。厉宏生大叫：“砍她右肩！”岳胜叫道：“先杀散加添柴火的！”赵安全叫道：“别跟老太婆纠缠，想法子打开厅门要紧！”周银兵放声大嚎：“热死啦！热死啦！”众人乱成一片。

    闵嘉庚何尝不知设法打开厅门乃是第一要务，但温老太拼死纠缠，始终缓不出手脚。他刀法高出温老太甚多，只此时局势特异，他年纪幼小，经历不足，难以镇定应付，数次得到可乘之机，都给温老太以拼命狠招拆解了。

    二人狠斗七八回合，温老太不住后退。温文新从佣工手中接过一柄单刀，再行上前夹攻。佣工初见主母与小主人手有武器，对付一个空手的孩子，只道稳可得胜，此刻见主母头发散乱，不住后退，显然不敌，各人持刀挺枪，纷纷加入战团。佣工武艺低微，给闵嘉庚刀砍足踢，霎时间伤了数人，但温家堡的佣工个个勇悍，负伤之下仍拒战不退。但听呐喊声、撞击声、呼喝斥骂声、柴火爆裂声，响成一片。

    大厅上各人听外面愈打愈乱，均想闵嘉庚一人虽勇，一个小孩子对敌温家堡上下，却如何能胜？于是有的咒骂，有的长叹，有的悲嚎，嘈杂之中又加上嘈杂。

    忽听一个声音叫道：“闵嘉庚听着：以阴阳诀先取主脑，以乱环诀散其附从。”这声音中气充沛，盖过了一切杂声，字字说得清清楚楚，正是王万户的话声。

    闵嘉庚见敌人越战越多，本已心神烦躁，不知如何是好，忽听王万户这几句话，心想王主任见识过人，所说必定不错，不由精神为之一振，钢刀呼呼呼三刀，往温老太中盘砍斫。他这把刀取自温文新，刃门虽已卷边，但只要砍中了，仍能致命。温老太见他来势猛恶，横刀急架，双刀碰撞时当当响了两下，第二下闵嘉庚从刚劲突转柔劲，自阳变阴，一收一挥，手腕忽地转了三个圈子。

    他是顺势而转，温老太的手臂却是逆转圈子，到第二个圈子时她手臂已转不过来，但觉肘骨剧痛，只得撒手放刀。那柄紫金刀激飞而起，射入天空。闵嘉庚阴阳诀出手建功，跟着一刀往她肩头直劈芦去。刀锋距她肩头约有半尺，只见她白发披肩，半边脸上满染血污，一个念头在心中一闪：“这老婆子委实可怜，怎能一刀将她砍死？”急忙刀身翻转，想用刀背撞她肩膀，使她无力再斗，便即赶去开门救人。

    不料温老太紫金刀脱手，心中立时便存了与仇人同归于尽的念头，见闵嘉庚举刀砍下，毫不闪避，反而抢上一步滚入他怀里，右手扣住他前胸“神封穴”，左手扣住他小腹“中注穴”牢牢抓定。闵嘉庚大惊，刀背用力击下。温老太嘿的一声，肩骨碎裂，但她不顾一切，抓住了闵嘉庚穴道死也不放，同时右足力勾，二人一起倒地。

    闵嘉庚直至此日方有临敌对战的经验，绝不知敌人拼命之时竟能如此狠法，被她抓住后只得出力挣扎。温老太一张口，又咬住了他前胸衣服，几个打滚，二人竟齐往大火堆中滚去。闵嘉庚大叫：“快放开，你不怕烧死么？”他心神一乱，竟忘了该使小擒拿手卸脱这贴身纠缠，惊惶中猛力回夺。二人又滚了几下，终于滚进了火堆。

    温文新大叫：“妈！”飞身来救，提起单刀，刀柄对准闵嘉庚天灵盖凿下。闵嘉庚偏头急避，刀柄还是打中了额角，疼得险些儿晕去。温文新生怕母亲受伤，忙伸手将二人从火堆中提出，看准闵嘉庚背心，一刀疾砍而下。

    就在这千钧一发的当口，闵嘉庚神智倏地清明，忽出怪招，右足反踢，正中温文新手腕，第二腿跟着踢出，这腿出尽全力，踢得温文新跌出五六丈外，一时爬不起来。

    闵嘉庚衣服着火，额角又疼痛欲裂，前胸与小腹均被温老太舍命扭住，忙抛下钢刀，大喝一声，双臂疾振，格格两响，已摆脱了温老太的纠缠，在地上一个打滚，滚熄衣上火焰。温老太上了年纪，给烟火一薰，已晕了过去。几名佣工忙给她扑打身上火头。

    闵嘉庚空手奔入人丛，心中对自己极是恼怒：“在这舍生忘死、狠命扑斗的当儿，我还要去可怜敌人，适才没送了小命，当真是无天理。”此时再不容情，夹手夺过一柄单刀，拳打足踢，刀劈肘撞，犹如虎入羊群，片刻间将佣工打得东逃西蹿。

    他奔到厅门前，从佣工手中夺过一柄火叉，将堆在门前的柴炭一阵乱挑乱拨，只见铁门已烧得通红，不禁大惊：“若是门钮与铁门烧得焊成一片，这门就打不开了。”危急中不及多想，提起单刀，将全身功劲运于右臂，奋力直砍下去，嗒的一声，门钮应手而落，这一砍用力过巨，单刀竟向上翘起，弯成了一把曲尺。他抛下单刀，用火叉钩住门环向外拉扯，竟然不动。闵嘉庚急得心怦怦乱跳：“莫要最后差着一点儿，铁门竟拉不开来！”他是小孩子心性，突然哇的一声哭了出来，再奋力狠拉，但听轧轧连声，铁门缓缓开了，黑烟夹着火头从门中直扑出来。

    他想不到厅中已烧得这般厉害，急叫：“王主任，快出来！”只见烟雾弥漫之中，一人当先抢出，正是厉宏生，接着李云、周银兵、岳胜、赵安全先后奔出，最后才是王万户抱着陈梦梅出来。各人衣衫焦烂，狼狈不堪。

    这时厅中木材都已着火，桌椅固已烧着，连梁柱也已大火熊熊。这时机当真相差不得片刻，倘若闵嘉庚再迟一盏茶工夫破门，必定有人丧命。闵嘉庚见王万户安然无恙，扑了上去，连叫：“王主任！王主任！”王万户须眉尽焦，但仍镇定如恒，微微一笑称赞：“好孩子！”
content_en:
Li Hongsheng suddenly shouted at the entrance of the cave: "Little brother, attack Mrs. Wen quickly. Her sword skills are unstable on all three." He had been immersed in the Bagua knife for decades, and he knew how she used the knife by listening to the sound of the sword wind.

    Min Jiageng was suffering from being unable to win for a while. When he heard Li Hongsheng's cry, he was overjoyed. He bent over and stretched out his fist to hit Mrs. Wen's leg. Mrs. Wen didn't even try to avoid it, she raised her knife and struck him directly on the back. She only wanted to hurt the enemy, not herself. Min Jiageng turned sideways to get out of the way of the knife, and Mrs. Wen struck with the second knife in succession. She clearly heard Li Hongsheng telling the enemy to attack her base, but she refused to defend it. Li Hongsheng shouted: "She is desperate and desperate, you can't take her knife away. Think of a way out!" Min Jiageng thought to himself: "I already knew this, why do you need to remind me? What can I do if I encounter such a crazy woman?"

    The battle outside the dog cave was fierce. With one against two, Min Jiageng gradually gained the upper hand, but it would take more than a hundred rounds to win. Mrs. Wen saw that the situation was unfavorable, and listened to Li Hongsheng yelling and pointing out the enemy, and told him the secret to breaking the Bagua Knife bit by bit. She was very angry and thought to herself: "You don't avenge your fellow martial brother, it's wrong, but you help the enemy instead, you are really a wolf-hearted traitor." She didn't want Li Hongsheng to be in a desperate situation. If he didn't help Min Jiageng, his life would not last more than a moment or three. In her rage, she thought: "This little bastard is very skilled in martial arts. Now that he has escaped, it will be difficult to kill him. Then burning these traitors in the hall will help a little bit of the evil in my heart." She shouted to the servants and quickly added more charcoal to burn them.

    Li Yun couldn't help but stamp his feet and complained that Min Jiageng was useless. Li Hongming said: "Director Wang, help us with hidden weapons quickly!" Wang Wanhu had already seized more than ten hidden weapons in his hands, but Mrs. Wen and three other people were fighting fiercely next to the dog hole, fighting close to each other, unable to see the target and launching based on illusions. How could they guarantee that they would not hit Min Jiageng? Min Jiageng was astute and had already thought of this, and tried to lure Mrs. Wen out of the dog cave several times. But Mrs. Wen was afraid of Wang Wanhu's hidden weapons, so she never fell into this trap.

    At this time, the burning smell in the hall became stronger and stronger. First, everyone's hair and beard curls were burnt, then the edges of their clothes were rolled up, and everyone's breathing gradually became difficult. Chen Mengmei couldn't bear the scorching heat and was half-conscious. In desperation, Zhou Yinbing stretched out his head and squeezed hard into the dog hole, but the hole was small and the head was big, so how could he get out? The four corners of the dog hole were made of extremely thick and heavy granite. He held it with both hands and shook it vigorously, but he couldn't move even an inch.

    Li Hongming suddenly remembered: "If Min Jiageng has a guy, how can Mrs. Wen be his rival? Why didn't I think of it earlier?" He immediately reached out to pick up the purple gold knife he threw on the ground. Unexpectedly, the blade of the knife touched the underground iron plate and was already extremely hot. As soon as he grabbed it, he screamed in pain. At this time, he could not stand for a moment in the iron hall. He endured the burn on his hands, tore off a piece of his clothes, wrapped it around the handle of the knife, pulled Zhou Yinbing away with his left hand, and shouted: "Min Jiageng, the guy is coming! Come on." With a wave of his hand, he threw the steel knife out of the dog hole. Min Jiageng turned around to pick it up. Wen Wenxin also heard the cry and came to snatch it at the same time. I heard both of them exclaiming at the same time, and with a clang, both knives fell to the ground.

    It turned out that Min Jiageng grabbed Li Hongming's single sword first, but the handle was extremely hot and he let go as soon as he caught it. Wen Wenxin jumped to the dog hole, but was hit on the wrist by Wang Wanhu's money dart, and the steel knife in his hand was also thrown down. Min Jiageng missed the target, and Mrs. Wen's purple-gold sword had already hit the back of his heart. He dodged sideways, rushed to Wen Wenxin's side, and suddenly used the "press the cow to drink water" move, raised his palm to press the back of his neck, and with a movement of strength, Wen Wenxin Xin pressed him straight down, his cheek fell to the ground, and he happened to touch Li Hongming's half-red-hot single knife. He let out a sneer, followed by a low scream, and a long scorch mark appeared on half of his handsome face.

    Everyone in the hall was overjoyed at this scream, only saying that Wen Wenxin had been injured by Min Jiageng. Mrs. Wen's desire for revenge and her love for mother and son were at war in her heart, and she ignored her son and hurriedly slashed at Min Jiageng's shoulder with the knife. There was a clang, but Min Jiageng did not dodge. He turned his wrist and crossed the knife. It turned out that he had taken the opportunity to grab Wen Wenxin's purple gold knife in his hand.

    Everyone in the hall was in the dark and extremely hot, but when they heard the clanging of the two swords, they knew that Min Jiageng had grabbed the weapon and was attacking with all his might, which gave them a little more hope. Li Hongsheng shouted: "Cut her right shoulder!" Yue Sheng shouted: "Kill the ones who add firewood first!" Zhao An'an shouted: "Don't get into trouble with the old woman, it's important to find a way to open the hall door!" Zhou Yinbing howled loudly: "It's so hot! It's so hot!" Everyone was in chaos.

    Min Jiageng didn't know that finding a way to open the hall door was his first priority, but Mrs. Wen struggled desperately and could not slow down. His swordsmanship was much better than that of Mrs. Wen, but the situation was unique at this time. He was young and inexperienced, and it was difficult for him to deal with it calmly. He got several opportunities, but Mrs. Wen used all her strength to dismantle them.

    The two fought fiercely for seven or eight rounds, and Mrs. Wen couldn't help but retreat. Wen Wenxin took a single sword from the servant and stepped forward to attack. When the servants first saw that their mistress and young master had weapons in their hands, they could only win with certainty against an empty-handed child. Now they saw that their mistress's hair was disheveled and she couldn't help but retreat. It was obvious that she was outmatched. Everyone held knives and guns, and joined the battle one after another. The servants had low martial arts skills and chopped and kicked Min Jiageng, injuring several people in an instant. However, Wenjiabao's servants were all brave and refused to retreat even though they were injured. But the sound of shouts, crashes, shouts and curses, and the crackling of firewood were all heard together.

    Everyone in the hall heard that the fighting outside was getting more and more chaotic, and they all thought that although Min Jiageng was brave, how could he win as a child against the entire Wenjiabao enemy? So some cursed, some sighed, and some wailed, adding noise to the noise.

    Suddenly I heard a voice shouting: "Listen, Min Jiageng: Use the Yin and Yang Jue to first capture the main brain, and use the Chaos Ring Jue to disperse its subordinates." This voice was full of energy, covering all the noise, and the words were clearly spoken. It was Wang Wanhu's voice.

    Min Jiageng saw that the enemy was getting more and more fighting, and he was already agitated and didn't know what to do. Suddenly he heard Wang Wanhu's words and thought that Director Wang had seen a lot of people and what he said must be true. His knife was taken from Wen Wenxin. Although the edge of the blade is curled, it can still be fatal if it hits. Mrs. Wen saw that he was coming with a fierce and vicious force, and she hurriedly raised her sword. When the two swords collided, they rang twice. The second time, Min Jiageng suddenly changed from strong to soft, from yang to yin. He drew back and waved, and his wrist suddenly turned three circles.

    He turned with the trend, but Mrs. Wen's arm reversed the circle. By the second circle, she could no longer turn her arm, but she felt severe pain in her elbow bone, so she had to let go and put the knife. The purple gold sword flew up and shot into the sky. Min Jiageng made a move using the Yin Yang Jue, and then struck her shoulder with a knife. The blade of the knife was about half a foot away from her shoulder. She saw her white hair shawl, and half of her face was stained with blood. A thought flashed in her mind: "This old woman is really pitiful, how can I chop her to death with one knife?" He quickly turned the blade over, trying to hit her shoulder with the back of the knife, making her unable to fight anymore, and then rushed to open the door to save people.

    Unexpectedly, Mrs. Wen let go of her purple-gold sword. She immediately had the idea of ​​dying with her enemy in her heart. When she saw Min Jiageng raising the sword to chop him down, she did not dodge. Instead, she took a step forward and rolled into his arms. She clasped the "Shenfeng Point" on his chest with her right hand and the "Zhongzhu Point" on his lower abdomen with her left hand to hold firmly. Min Jiageng was shocked and struck down hard with the back of his knife. Mrs. Wen let out a cry, her shoulder bones shattered, but regardless of everything, she grabbed Min Jiageng's acupoint and refused to let go. At the same time, she hooked hard with her right foot, and they fell to the ground together.

    Min Jiageng had no experience in facing hostile battles until now. He had no idea that the enemy could be so ruthless when desperate. After being caught by her, he had to struggle hard. Old Mrs. Wen opened her mouth and bit his shirt on the chest. After a few rolls, they both rolled towards the fire. Min Jiageng shouted: "Let go quickly, aren't you afraid of being burned to death?" He was so confused that he forgot to use his hands to free himself from the tight entanglement, and in panic, he violently snatched it back. The two rolled a few more times and finally rolled into the fire.

    Wen Wenxin shouted: "Mom!" He flew to the rescue, raised his single knife, aimed the handle at Min Jiageng's Tianling Cap, and cut it off. Min Jiageng turned his head to avoid it, but the handle of the knife still hit his forehead, and he almost fainted from the pain. Wen Wenxinsheng was afraid that his mother would be injured, so he hurriedly stretched out his hand to lift the two of them out of the fire, looked at Min Jiageng's vest, and slashed down with a sharp knife.

    At this critical moment, Min Jiageng's mind suddenly became clear, and he suddenly made a strange move, kicking back with his right foot, hitting Wen Wenxin's wrist, and then kicked out his second leg. This leg kicked with all his strength, causing Wen Wenxin to fall five or six feet away, unable to get up for a while.

    Min Jiageng's clothes were on fire, his forehead was in splitting pain, and his chest and lower abdomen were being twisted by Old Mrs. Wen desperately. He quickly dropped the steel knife, shouted loudly, and shook his arms rapidly with two rattling sounds. He got rid of Old Mrs. Wen's entanglement and rolled on the ground, extinguishing the flames on his clothes. Mrs. Wen was old and fainted after being exposed to fireworks. Several helpers were busy beating the fire on her body.

    Min Jiageng ran into the crowd empty-handed, feeling very angry with himself: "At this time when I was risking my life and fighting fiercely, I still wanted to pity the enemy. I didn't lose my life just now. It's really unreasonable." At this time, he was no longer merciless and grabbed a single sword between his hands. He punched, kicked, and elbowed him with the knife, just like a tiger entering a flock of sheep. In a moment, he beat the servants away and fled.

    He rushed to the hall door, grabbed a fire fork from the servant's hand, and started to stir up the charcoal piled in front of the door. He saw that the iron door was burning red, and he couldn't help being shocked: "If the door knob and the iron door are welded together, the door cannot be opened. It's open." In the critical situation, he didn't think much. He raised the single sword, channeled all his strength into his right arm, and slashed straight down. With a click, the door button fell down. The force of the cut was too great, and the single sword actually tilted up and bent into a curved ruler. He threw down his single sword, hooked the firefork on the door knocker and pulled it outward, but it didn't move. Min Jiageng was so anxious that his heart was beating wildly: "Don't miss it in the end, and the iron door can't be opened!" He was a child at heart, and suddenly cried out, and he tried hard to pull, but after hearing a continuous crunching sound, the iron door slowly opened, and black smoke mixed with flames rushed out from the door.

    He didn't expect the hall to be so burned, so he shouted urgently: "Director Wang, come out quickly!" He saw one person rushing out of the smoke, Li Hongsheng, followed by Li Yun, Zhou Yinbing, Yue Sheng, Zhao An'an, and finally Wang Wanhu came out holding Chen Mengmei. Everyone's clothes were burnt to pieces and they were in a miserable state.

    At this time, the wood in the hall was on fire, the tables and chairs were on fire, and even the beams and pillars were in flames. The timing was close to the truth. If Min Jiageng broke in after a cup of tea, someone would definitely die. Seeing that Wang Wanhu was safe and sound, Min Jiageng rushed forward and shouted: "Director Wang! Director Wang!" Wang Wanhu's eyebrows were all anxious, but he remained calm. He smiled slightly and praised: "Good boy!"
